stem: Which claim does the author make in the selection “Laws for Less Trash”?

options.label: A
options.text: People should make sure their neighbors know about recycling laws and reminders.

options.label: B
options.text: Laws and reminders are the best way to make recycling in the city better.

options.label: C
options.text: People will move to cities that have recycling laws and reminders.

options.label: D
options.text: Laws and reminders about recycling work better in some places than in others.
